verdict.rationale: monday.com documents agents, a hosted and developer MCP, and app building (monday vibe, apps framework), so agent self-verification is a fair question for this product. However, nothing in the evidence shows an agent navigating the app UI or capturing before-and-after screenshots to verify its own work. Programmatic agent control, audit logs, and sandboxed deployment are adjacent capabilities and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can have an agent verify its own implementation by navigating the app and capturing before-and-after screenshots
